summary: The Trump administration is proposing significant federal spending to maintain a National Guard presence in D.C. through 2029, while simultaneously advancing what DC statehood advocates characterize as threats to the district's fiscal independence and local control. DC Vote and other home-rule advocates are opposing what they describe as federal overreach into DC governance, including recent comments from the administration targeting local leadership.
